audit.whatIsWrong: tldr, loading, dosFull[2].t, report[0].t and report[10].t refer to Leona with 'His'/'his'/'he', per lintFindings MISGENDER.
audit.why: Leona is she/her; the owner (Nami) is addressed as 'you', so third-person pronouns refer to the enemy.
audit.corrected: Replace 'His'/'his'/'he' with 'Her'/'her'/'she' in all five fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Zenith Blade and Nami's own Q generically with no real cooldown numbers, and the packet flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Zenith Blade (E) is 12/10.5/9/7.5/6s, Shield of Daybreak (Q) is a flat 5s with an auto-attack-reset tell, and Solar Flare (R) is 90/75/60s — real numbers give a concrete punish window.
audit.corrected: Cite the real cooldowns and add the auto-reset wind-up tell from missingInteractions.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never mentions that Leona's combo opens with an auto-attack reset on Shield of Daybreak (Q) — the wind-up, not the cast, is the real tell to step back.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags rule autoreset-burst-tell for this matchup.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreement: full phases[0,2,3,4,5,6].side all say 'Skill' while content win[] says Nami/Skill/Leona/Leona/Leona/Leona/Nami. Level 2 (row 1) already agrees at 'Skill' on both layers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches content.win[] exactly, so content is the accurate side and full is stale/templated.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0].side and phases[6].side to 'Nami', and phases[2,3,4,5].side to 'Leona', with why text grounded in the existing (accurate) content whys[]: ranged poke wins level 1 before she has an engage, her E-Q lockdown chain takes over from 3 through first item, and Nami's disengage/sustain retakes the lead with 2+ items.
